evidence: ENVIRONMENT-NAME IS ENVNM / ENVIRONMENT-VALUE IS ENVVAL
DISPLAY ... UPON ENVNM / ACCEPT ... FROM ENVVAL

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese non-life insurance joint pool (共同プール) reporting system; generates CSV list output for pool risk data
purpose.summary: This program is part of the INS-CALI insurance system and edits/outputs a joint pool list (共同プールリスト). It reads master and transaction files, merges them by key comparison, and writes results to multiple CSV output files. It also retrieves environment variables for Oracle DB credentials and run parameters, and calls a handler routine to look up the insurance company name.

notable_features: ORGANIZATION IS CSV on output files
ENVIRONMENT-NAME/ENVIRONMENT-VALUE special names for environment variable access
Multiple COPY directives for copybooks (KE0014C, JS0031C, KY0005C)
CALL to KY0011S subprogram for DB handler
Debugging lines prefixed with D (conditional debug display)
Japanese-language comments and change history spanning 2011-2023
RECORD CONTAINS size changes documented in comments (AS migration, UAT defect fixes)
COMPUTE for fiscal year (年度) calculation
verdict.notes: File contains extensive Japanese-language comments and a detailed change history from 2011 to 2023, indicating a long-lived production system. The CSV ORGANIZATION clause and environment variable pattern are characteristic of Fujitsu NetCOBOL or a similar Japanese vendor COBOL runtime. The DATA DIVISION working-storage section is not shown (likely in copybooks), so PIC count is low. Dialect confidence is medium because Fujitsu vs. NEC vs. Hitachi cannot be definitively distinguished without more context.
